# Cressida Lindsay

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Mount Holly  <sub>[v3 c21 P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** belle and beauty of the class  <sub>[v3 c6 P13](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0013)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Cressy  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>; Cressida Lindsay  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>; Cressy Hale  <sub>[v3 c41 P31](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0031)</sub>

## Appearance

Cressy possesses a remarkable beauty and charm with large brown eyes, a lopsided smile, and curls. At her wedding, she appeared like a delicate, ethereal fairy. Later, after having children, she remarked that she had grown dreadfully skinny.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c27 P3](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0003), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044)_

## Personality

Cressy is composed, entertaining, and free from snobbery, possessing a very loyal and passionate nature toward her friends. Though somewhat indecisive, thoughtless, and prone to dramatic declarations, she lightens situations with her bright humor and small talk. She dislikes disagreeable topics and broken hearts, yet possesses a deep capacity for affection and selflessness.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c5 P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005), [v3 c10 P53](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0053), [v3 c10 P65](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0065), [v3 c20 P3](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0003), [v3 c20 P7](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0007), [v3 c36 P23](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0023)_

- to get Mr. Hale (Ezra) to propose marriage to her  <sub>[v3 c25 P23](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0023)</sub>

## History

Cressy entered Wexcombe College as a Freshman, quickly becoming popular due to her elite lineage and charming personality. She introduced her friends Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis into various social circles across college. During her studies, she moved into Tabby’s Place as a housemate alongside Nell, Honora, and Mabel Colby, adapting to house rules and acquiring domestic skills. Courted by numerous suitors including Hector and Orlando, she met the Reverend Ezra Hale while spending a summer month at Prospect Point and fell in love with him. Despite her mother's initial disapproval, she successfully brought Ezra to her family home at Mount Holly and secured her parents' consent. Cressy earned Honors in Mathematics upon completing her final year at Wexcombe. She married Ezra in June, with Nell serving as her bridesmaid, and subsequently gave birth to infants while remaining in close contact with her friends.

## Quotes

> No, no, my dear. Shyness is not one of the numerous faults—or good qualities—possessed by Cressida Lindsay—Cressy as a nickname. Please use Cressy for me from the start. Well then, what are your names?  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

> Oh, why should that matter to me? It is far superior to share a simple meal of herbs alongside your friends than to eat a fattened ox in an isolated boardinghouse.
